title.en: Bihar Draft Rules under the Labour Codes, 2025
title.hi: श्रम संहिता के अंतर्गत बिहार प्रारूप नियम, 2025

summary.en: Draft rules to operationalise the four central Labour Codes (Wages; Industrial Relations; Social Security; Occupational Safety, Health & Working Conditions) in Bihar. Notified for public objections and suggestions (an extended period was notified). Open for public comment — confirm the current deadline and submission address in the official notification.
summary.hi: बिहार में चार केंद्रीय श्रम संहिताओं (वेतन; औद्योगिक संबंध; सामाजिक सुरक्षा; व्यावसायिक सुरक्षा, स्वास्थ्य एवं कार्यदशा) को लागू करने हेतु प्रारूप नियम। आम जनता से आपत्ति एवं सुझाव हेतु अधिसूचित। टिप्पणी हेतु खुला — वर्तमान समय-सीमा व पता आधिकारिक अधिसूचना से सत्यापित करें।

original.how_to_comment_en: 1. Read the draft rules (document link). 2. Write your objection/suggestion citing the specific rule number. 3. Send it to the Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar, within the notified period. 4. Confirm the current deadline and exact submission address (email/post) in the official notification before sending.
original.how_to_comment_hi: 1. प्रारूप नियम पढ़ें (दस्तावेज़ लिंक)। 2. संबंधित नियम संख्या का उल्लेख करते हुए अपनी आपत्ति/सुझाव लिखें। 3. इसे अधिसूचित अवधि के भीतर श्रम संसाधन विभाग, बिहार सरकार को भेजें। 4. भेजने से पूर्व वर्तमान समय-सीमा एवं सटीक पता (ईमेल/डाक) आधिकारिक अधिसूचना से सत्यापित करें।

summary.en: Aims for 15% EVs in all vehicle registrations by 2028. Offers up to 75% Motor Vehicle Tax subsidy and purchase incentives up to ₹1.25 lakh for the first 1,000 personal four-wheeler EVs, plus support for charging infrastructure.
summary.hi: 2028 तक सभी वाहन पंजीकरण में 15% EV का लक्ष्य। 75% तक मोटर वाहन कर सब्सिडी एवं पहले 1,000 निजी चार-पहिया EV हेतु ₹1.25 लाख तक खरीद प्रोत्साहन, साथ ही चार्जिंग अवसंरचना हेतु सहायता।

summary.en: Bihar's framework to build a semiconductor and electronics manufacturing ecosystem, approved by the state cabinet in February 2026. Offers land, stamp-duty and capital incentives to attract chip fabrication and ATMP investment, overseen by a dedicated Bihar Semiconductor Mission. Verify incentive specifics and eligibility against the official policy document.
summary.hi: सेमीकंडक्टर व इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स विनिर्माण पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र बनाने हेतु बिहार की रूपरेखा, फरवरी 2026 में राज्य कैबिनेट द्वारा अनुमोदित। चिप निर्माण व ATMP निवेश आकर्षित करने हेतु भूमि, स्टांप शुल्क व पूँजी प्रोत्साहन; एक समर्पित बिहार सेमीकंडक्टर मिशन द्वारा निगरानी। प्रोत्साहन विवरण व पात्रता आधिकारिक नीति दस्तावेज़ से सत्यापित करें।

summary.en: Provide affordable subsidised rental housing to urban migrants and urban poor (EWS/LIG) near their workplaces, reducing distress and unsafe living conditions for industrial and construction workers, street vendors, and similar groups.
summary.hi: शहरी प्रवासियों एवं शहरी गरीबों (EWS/LIG) को उनके कार्यस्थल के निकट किफायती किराया आवास उपलब्ध कराना, ताकि औद्योगिक/निर्माण श्रमिकों, रेहड़ी-पटरी वालों आदि की परेशानी एवं असुरक्षित आवास की स्थिति कम हो सके।

records.evidence: Fetched official PMAY-Urban ARHC page (pmay-urban.gov.in/arhc-about): launched 8 July 2020 under PMAY-Urban as a sub-scheme for urban migrants/poor; Model 1 (govt housing stock) and Model 2 (private/public land) operational; cities listed Bihar among potential implementation states. No current-FY Bihar-specific budget confirmation found — likely_active. Distinct from PMAY-Urban (ownership housing) — ARHC is specifically a rental sub-scheme.

department.en: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India (sub-scheme of PMAY-Urban)
department.hi: आवास एवं शहरी कार्य मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार (PMAY-शहरी की उप-योजना)

benefits.en: Access to subsidised rental housing in ARHCs comprising single-bedroom (~30 sq m) and double-bedroom (~60 sq m) dwelling units plus 4-6 bed dormitories, at affordable rents. Complexes developed on existing government-funded vacant housing stock or by private/public entities on their own land through PPP.

text.en: Urban migrants and urban poor in the EWS / LIG categories — including industrial workers, construction workers, street vendors, rickshaw pullers, market/trade workers — seeking affordable rental housing near their workplace in urban areas.
text.hi: EWS/LIG श्रेणी के शहरी प्रवासी एवं शहरी गरीब — जैसे औद्योगिक/निर्माण श्रमिक, रेहड़ी-पटरी वाले, रिक्शा चालक, बाजार/व्यापार कर्मी — जो शहरी क्षेत्र में कार्यस्थल के निकट किफायती किराया आवास चाहते हों।

title.en: Bihar State Housing Board — Housing Allotment (e-Lottery)
title.hi: बिहार राज्य आवास बोर्ड — आवास आवंटन (ई-लॉटरी)

summary.en: The Bihar State Housing Board (a statutory body established in 1972) develops integrated residential colonies — plots, flats and apartments across income categories (EWS / LIG / MIG / HIG) — and allots dwelling units to the public through a transparent online e-lottery. It also runs property e-auctions and lease-hold to free-hold conversion for existing allottees.
summary.hi: बिहार राज्य आवास बोर्ड (1972 में स्थापित एक सांविधिक निकाय) सभी आय वर्गों (EWS / LIG / MIG / HIG) हेतु एकीकृत आवासीय कॉलोनियाँ — भूखंड, फ्लैट एवं अपार्टमेंट — विकसित करता है तथा पारदर्शी ऑनलाइन ई-लॉटरी के माध्यम से आम जनता को आवास आवंटित करता है। यह संपत्ति की ई-नीलामी तथा मौजूदा आवंटियों हेतु लीज-होल्ड से फ्री-होल्ड रूपांतरण भी करता है।

records.evidence: Likely active — the Bihar State Housing Board (est. 1972) operates an active official portal (bshb.bihar.gov.in) carrying schemes, online application, e-auction and lease-to-freehold modules, and has ongoing procurement (300+ live e-tenders, plus a proposed residential complex at Ara under environmental clearance). No scheme-wise budget line is published for the Board (its allotment activity is largely self-financing), and a specific current allotment/e-lottery advertisement could not be confirmed at verification, so this is likely_active rather than active. Verified 2026-06-25.

department.en: Bihar State Housing Board, Urban Development & Housing Department, Government of Bihar
department.hi: बिहार राज्य आवास बोर्ड, नगर विकास एवं आवास विभाग, बिहार सरकार

benefits.en: Allotment of a residential plot, flat or apartment in a Board-developed colony, priced by income category, via online application and e-lottery. EWS/LIG units are offered at subsidised rates. Existing allottees can apply for lease-hold to free-hold conversion; surplus/commercial units are sold through e-auction on the Bihar e-Procurement portal.

text.en: Open to the general public across income categories (EWS / LIG / MIG / HIG). Income eligibility for a given unit is set by the prevailing policy and stated in each project's advertisement / brochure. Key rule: if the applicant or any family member has already been allotted a dwelling unit or residential plot in any BSHB project, they are not eligible to apply again in a subsequent project. Applications are submitted online and units allotted by e-lottery.
text.hi: सभी आय वर्गों (EWS / LIG / MIG / HIG) की आम जनता हेतु खुला। किसी इकाई के लिए आय पात्रता प्रचलित नीति द्वारा निर्धारित होती है और प्रत्येक परियोजना के विज्ञापन / विवरणिका में दी जाती है। मुख्य नियम: यदि आवेदक या उसके परिवार के किसी सदस्य को बोर्ड की किसी परियोजना में पहले ही आवास इकाई या भूखंड आवंटित हो चुका है, तो वह किसी बाद की परियोजना हेतु पुनः आवेदन के पात्र नहीं हैं। आवेदन ऑनलाइन जमा होते हैं और इकाइयाँ ई-लॉटरी द्वारा आवंटित की जाती हैं।

title.en: BSDM Domain Skilling Program (Bihar Skill Development Mission)
title.hi: बिहार कौशल विकास मिशन - डोमेन स्किलिंग कार्यक्रम

summary.en: Provide employment-linked, sector-specific (domain) vocational skill training to Bihar's youth beyond the foundational Kushal Yuva Program, building a standardised, ICT-monitored skill ecosystem with placement facilitation; includes dedicated tracks for PwD/Divyangjan and transgender candidates.
summary.hi: कुशल युवा कार्यक्रम से आगे बढ़कर बिहार के युवाओं को रोजगार-संबद्ध, क्षेत्र-विशिष्ट (डोमेन) व्यावसायिक कौशल प्रशिक्षण देना, साथ ही प्लेसमेंट सहायता तथा दिव्यांग एवं ट्रांसजेंडर हेतु समर्पित ट्रैक।

records.evidence: Bihar Skill Development Mission's official portal lists Domain Skilling as a flagship program alongside KYP; recent BSDM Requests for Proposal to empanel Training Partners for Domain Skilling and for PwD/Transgender skilling (RFP cycles up to 2026) indicate active procurement and ongoing operation. Current-FY budget allocation not separately confirmed from budget.bihar.gov.in, hence likely_active. Distinct from Kushal Yuva Program already in catalogue.

department.en: Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar (implemented by Bihar Skill Development Mission, Patna)
department.hi: श्रम संसाधन विभाग, बिहार सरकार (बिहार कौशल विकास मिशन, पटना द्वारा कार्यान्वित)

benefits.en: Free job-oriented domain/sector-specific skill training through empanelled Training Partners, government-recognised certification on completion, and placement assistance into relevant sectors. Dedicated PwD and transgender skilling tracks are being empanelled.

text.en: Bihar-resident youth seeking sector-specific skilling (general domain skilling builds on KYP-type foundational eligibility); a dedicated PwD/Divyangjan and transgender track covers candidates aged 15-59. Apply via the BSDM portal.
text.hi: क्षेत्र-विशिष्ट कौशल चाहने वाले बिहार-निवासी युवा; दिव्यांग/ट्रांसजेंडर हेतु समर्पित ट्रैक 15–59 आयु के अभ्यर्थियों को कवर करता है। BSDM पोर्टल पर आवेदन।

records.evidence: Fetched the official Bihar Bhawan page (biharbhawan.gov.in/cmReliefFund.aspx), which is live and describes the income-based eligibility (income < ₹2.5 lakh), CGHS-empanelled-hospital treatment, an application route via Bihar Bhawan New Delhi, and active helplines (WhatsApp +91 8527595623; Jigyasa 0612-2233333). Marked likely_active rather than active because the page does not show a current budget line, the full covered-disease list, or the exact benefit ceiling — those were in a linked PDF I could not parse.

department.hi: कौशल विकास एवं उद्यमिता मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार; बिहार में तकनीकी शिक्षा निदेशालय / ITI नेटवर्क द्वारा कार्यान्वित

benefits.en: Long-duration (6 months to 2 years) NSQF-compliant vocational training across ~150 engineering and non-engineering trades (including dedicated trades for women and PwDs), leading to a National Trade Certificate (NTC) recognised by industry and government. Training at government and private ITIs with workshops, tools and equipment provided.

text.en: Youth seeking trade/craftsman skills; admission through ITIs with trade- and duration-specific entry requirements (generally Class 8 or Class 10 pass depending on trade); minimum age 14. Open to Bihar residents through government and private ITIs across the state.
text.hi: कौशल/शिल्पकार प्रशिक्षण चाहने वाले युवा; ITI में ट्रेड एवं अवधि के अनुसार प्रवेश (सामान्यतः कक्षा 8 या 10 उत्तीर्ण, ट्रेड-अनुसार); न्यूनतम आयु 14 वर्ष। बिहार के सरकारी एवं निजी ITI के माध्यम से बिहार निवासियों हेतु।

original.eligibility_hi: कौशल/शिल्पकार प्रशिक्षण चाहने वाले युवा; ITI में ट्रेड एवं अवधि के अनुसार प्रवेश (सामान्यतः कक्षा 8 या 10 उत्तीर्ण, ट्रेड-अनुसार); न्यूनतम आयु 14 वर्ष। बिहार के सरकारी एवं निजी ITI के माध्यम से बिहार निवासियों हेतु।
original.benefit_detail: Long-duration (6 months to 2 years) NSQF-compliant vocational training across ~150 engineering and non-engineering trades (including dedicated trades for women and PwDs), leading to a National Trade Certificate (NTC) recognised by industry and government. Training at government and private ITIs with workshops, tools and equipment provided.
original.status_evidence: Fetched official Bihar Technical Education (det.bihar.gov.in/cts.html) page confirming CTS operates through the Bihar ITI network; MSDE/DGT national scheme with active admissions across ~15,000 ITIs nationwide including in Bihar. NTC certification is government-recognised.

title.en: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) — Bihar
title.hi: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्रामीण कौशल्य योजना

summary.en: Transform economically disadvantaged rural youth into self-reliant, market-relevant workers through placement-linked, market-driven skill training, with a focus on poor rural households.
summary.hi: स्थान-संबद्ध, बाजार-आधारित कौशल प्रशिक्षण के माध्यम से गरीब ग्रामीण युवाओं को आत्मनिर्भर, बाजार-प्रासंगिक कामगार बनाना।

records.evidence: BRLPS/JEEViKA official skills-and-jobs page details DDU-GKY as a currently-run program with placement targets and ongoing Expression of Interest for training partners in Bihar; central MoRD scheme remains active on the unified kaushal.rural.gov.in portal. JEEViKA is named as the standing nodal agency for Bihar.

department.en: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India (under NRLM); implemented in Bihar by the State Rural Livelihoods Mission / Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society (BRLPS - JEEViKA) as nodal agency
department.hi: ग्रामीण विकास मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार (NRLM के अंतर्गत); बिहार में बिहार ग्रामीण आजीविका संवर्धन समिति (BRLPS — जीविका) द्वारा कार्यान्वित

benefits.en: Free, fully residential or non-residential market-driven skill training with national/internationally aligned certification, mandatory placement support (target of at least 70-75% of trained candidates placed in jobs), post-placement support and migration/handholding assistance.

text.en: Rural poor youth aged 15-35 (up to 45 for women, PVTGs, PwDs, transgender persons and special groups), identified as poor via Participatory Identification of Poor, BPL/SECC auto-inclusion, MGNREGA households, RSBY/Antyodaya cardholders or NRLM SHG membership. Mandatory coverage for SC/ST (34%), minorities (13%) and women (33%). Bihar-resident rural youth apply through JEEViKA/training partners.
text.hi: 15–35 वर्ष (महिलाओं, PVTG, दिव्यांग, ट्रांसजेंडर हेतु 45 तक) के ग्रामीण गरीब युवा, जिनकी पहचान PIP/BPL/SECC/मनरेगा परिवार या NRLM SHG सदस्यता से होती है। SC/ST (34%), अल्पसंख्यक (13%), महिला (33%) अनिवार्य कवरेज। जीविका/प्रशिक्षण भागीदारों के माध्यम से आवेदन।

title.en: Housing Accommodation for Women Government Employees (near place of posting)
title.hi: महिला सरकारी कर्मियों हेतु आवास सुविधा (पदस्थापन स्थल के निकट)

summary.en: Provide safe, affordable rental accommodation to women state-government employees at or near their place of posting — especially those serving in rural and block-level offices — to improve their safety and convenience. Where government quarters are unavailable, the state leases private housing for them.
summary.hi: महिला राज्य-सरकारी कर्मियों को उनके पदस्थापन स्थल पर या उसके निकट सुरक्षित एवं किफायती किराया आवास उपलब्ध कराना — विशेषकर ग्रामीण एवं प्रखंड-स्तरीय कार्यालयों में कार्यरत महिलाओं को — ताकि उनकी सुरक्षा एवं सुविधा बढ़े। जहाँ सरकारी आवास उपलब्ध न हो, वहाँ सरकार उनके लिए निजी आवास पट्टे पर लेगी।

records.evidence: Likely active — approved by the Bihar Cabinet on 10 June 2025 (chaired by CM Nitish Kumar) to provide accommodation near posting for ~4 lakh women government employees. As of verification the scheme is in early rollout: implementing departments are to begin formalities, district committees and landlord expressions-of-interest are the delivery mechanism, and no application portal, budget line, or formal operating guidelines have been published yet. No official government notification/PDF located — sourced from news coverage of the cabinet decision; replace source_url with the official notification when available. Verified 2026-06-25.

department.en: Government of Bihar (Cabinet-approved; implemented via district administration / DM-led committees)
department.hi: बिहार सरकार (कैबिनेट द्वारा स्वीकृत; जिला प्रशासन / डीएम की अध्यक्षता वाली समितियों द्वारा क्रियान्वित)

benefits.en: Rent-free or government-leased private accommodation near the employee's posting, arranged by a district-level committee chaired by the District Magistrate, which identifies suitable buildings (with electricity, water, sanitation and structural safety) and executes lease agreements with landlords; the Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) finalises the rent and handles grievances. Rollout is phased — beginning at district and divisional headquarters before expanding. Specific rent ceilings have not been published.

text.en: Women employees of the Bihar state government posted in the state — reported to include schoolteachers, women officers and staff, police personnel, and women working from the panchayat level up to the secretariat. Priority emphasis on those posted at rural / block-level offices. Employees opting for this government-provided accommodation forgo House Rent Allowance (HRA).
text.hi: बिहार राज्य सरकार की महिला कर्मी जो राज्य में पदस्थापित हैं — समाचारों के अनुसार इसमें शिक्षिकाएँ, महिला अधिकारी एवं कर्मचारी, पुलिसकर्मी, तथा पंचायत स्तर से सचिवालय तक कार्यरत महिलाएँ शामिल हैं। ग्रामीण / प्रखंड-स्तरीय कार्यालयों में पदस्थापित महिलाओं को प्राथमिकता। यह सरकारी आवास चुनने वाली कर्मी मकान किराया भत्ता (HRA) नहीं लेंगी।

summary.en: Eliminate out-of-pocket expenses for pregnant women delivering in public health institutions and for treatment of sick newborns and infants, thereby promoting institutional delivery and infant survival.

records.evidence: Fetched the NHM/MoHFW JSSK page (nhm.gov.in, level=3 sublinkid=842), which describes JSSK as launched 1 June 2011, extended in 2014, and currently entitling all pregnant women and sick infants to free services in public facilities — an ongoing NHM program operating across all states including Bihar.

department.en: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (implemented in Bihar by State Health Society, Bihar)
department.hi: राष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य मिशन, स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण मंत्रालय (बिहार में राज्य स्वास्थ्य समिति द्वारा कार्यान्वित)

benefits.en: Entirely free, zero-expense services at public health institutions: free delivery including caesarean section; free drugs and consumables; free diagnostics; free blood when required; free diet (3 days for normal delivery, 7 days for C-section); and free transport (home-to-institution, inter-facility referral, and drop-back). Same free entitlements extended to sick newborns and infants up to one year of age.

text.en: All pregnant women delivering in public health institutions, and all sick newborns/infants up to one year of age accessing public health institutions. No application or income test — entitlements are automatic at government facilities.
text.hi: सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य संस्थानों में प्रसव कराने वाली सभी गर्भवती महिलाएँ, तथा एक वर्ष तक के सभी बीमार नवजात/शिशु। कोई आवेदन या आय-परीक्षण नहीं — सरकारी सुविधाओं में स्वतः लाभ।

summary.en: Reduce maternal and neonatal mortality by promoting institutional delivery among poor pregnant women through conditional cash assistance.
summary.hi: गरीब गर्भवती महिलाओं में संस्थागत प्रसव को बढ़ावा देकर मातृ एवं नवजात मृत्यु-दर घटाना, सशर्त नकद सहायता के माध्यम से।

records.evidence: Fetched the NHM/MoHFW JSY page (nhm.gov.in, level=3 lid=309), which describes JSY as a current 100% centrally-sponsored NHM scheme with active cash-assistance amounts and special focus on Bihar as a Low Performing State. State Health Society Bihar maintains a live JSY maternal-health programme page (shs.bihar.gov.in) confirming state implementation. Could not pull an exact current-FY Bihar budget figure, but it is an ongoing core NHM intervention.

department.en: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (implemented in Bihar by State Health Society, Bihar)
department.hi: राष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य मिशन, स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण मंत्रालय (बिहार में राज्य स्वास्थ्य समिति द्वारा कार्यान्वित)

benefits.en: Cash transfer on institutional delivery. In Low Performing States (which include Bihar): ₹1,400 to a rural mother + ₹600 to ASHA; ₹1,000 to an urban mother + ₹400 to ASHA. Entire entitlement disbursed to the mother in one go at the health institution.

text.en: Bihar is classified as a Low Performing State, so all pregnant women delivering in a government health centre (Sub Centre/PHC/CHC) are eligible (in High Performing States only BPL/SC/ST women qualify). ASHA acts as the link facilitating the delivery.
text.hi: बिहार 'कम-प्रदर्शन राज्य' है, अतः सरकारी स्वास्थ्य केंद्र में प्रसव कराने वाली सभी गर्भवती महिलाएँ पात्र हैं। ASHA प्रसव में सहायता करती है।

title.en: Mukhyamantri Vas Sthal Kray Sahayata Yojana
title.hi: मुख्यमंत्री वास स्थल क्रय सहायता योजना

summary.en: Help landless and houseless rural families who are listed as PMAY-G beneficiaries but have no homestead land to first acquire residential land, so they can subsequently avail house-construction assistance under PMAY-G.
summary.hi: ऐसे ग्रामीण परिवारों की सहायता करना जो PMAY-ग्रामीण के लाभार्थी हैं किन्तु भूमिहीन हैं, ताकि वे आवासीय भूखंड क्रय कर सकें और फिर मकान-निर्माण सहायता प्राप्त कर सकें।

records.evidence: Listed as a live scheme on the Government of India myScheme portal (myscheme.gov.in/schemes/mmvsksy, Rural Development Dept, Bihar) and widely referenced in 2025 state sources as currently open. No current-FY Bihar Rural Development budget allocation confirmed — classed likely_active. Benefit amount discrepancy (Rs. 60,000 on myScheme vs Rs. 1 lakh in some 2025 news) flagged for re-verification against an RD notification. Distinct from Bihar Vaas Bhoomi Yojana (Revenue & Land Reforms free land grant — different dept and mechanism).

department.en: Rural Development Department, Government of Bihar

benefits.en: Cash assistance of Rs. 60,000 transferred directly (DBT) to the beneficiary's bank account, to be used exclusively for purchasing residential/homestead land. (Note: some 2025 sources report the amount revised upward to Rs. 1 lakh — re-verify against a Rural Development Department notification.)

text.en: Rural Bihar resident; listed as a beneficiary under PMAY-Gramin; landless and houseless (owns no residential land/house); resides in a village where no government land is available for housing allocation; must have an operational bank account for DBT.
text.hi: ग्रामीण बिहार निवासी; PMAY-ग्रामीण के लाभार्थी सूची में नाम; भूमिहीन एवं बेघर (कोई आवासीय भूमि/मकान नहीं); ऐसे गाँव में रहते हों जहाँ सरकारी भूमि उपलब्ध नहीं; DBT हेतु बैंक खाता आवश्यक।

summary.en: Promote apprenticeship training across the country by incentivising employers to engage apprentices, thereby giving youth (including ITI pass-outs, school pass-outs and skill-certificate holders) industry-based, paid, on-the-job skilling.
summary.hi: नियोक्ताओं को शिक्षुओं को रखने हेतु प्रोत्साहित कर शिक्षुता को बढ़ावा देना, जिससे युवाओं (ITI उत्तीर्ण, स्कूल उत्तीर्ण, कौशल-प्रमाणपत्रधारक) को सवेतन, उद्योग-आधारित ऑन-द-जॉब कौशल मिले।

records.evidence: MSDE NAPS implementation guidelines (2024) and the May 2025 38th Central Apprenticeship Council decision revising stipends by 36% confirm the scheme is current and actively funded for 2025-26; quarterly reimbursement to employers is ongoing via RDATs/State Apprenticeship Advisors. Central scheme operated through apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.

department.en: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) / Directorate General of Training (DGT); in Bihar coordinated via the Regional Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (RDSDE) and the apprenticeshipindia.gov.in portal
department.hi: कौशल विकास एवं उद्यमिता मंत्रालय (MSDE) / प्रशिक्षण महानिदेशालय; बिहार में apprenticeshipindia.gov.in पोर्टल द्वारा

benefits.en: Apprentices receive a prescribed monthly stipend (revised in May 2025 to a range of approx. Rs 6,800-Rs 12,300/month), of which the Government contributes 25% of the prescribed minimum stipend up to Rs 1,500/month directly via DBT; for non-ITI candidates the Government also shares basic training cost up to Rs 7,500 for 500 hours/3 months. Apprentices gain certified, industry-recognised work experience.

text.en: Indian citizens aged 14+ (18+ for hazardous trades) with minimum 5th-class education; ITI pass-outs, Class 8/10/12 pass candidates, diploma holders, graduates and skill-certificate holders are eligible depending on trade. Open to Bihar youth; engagement is through registered employers/establishments on the apprenticeship portal.
text.hi: 14 वर्ष से अधिक (खतरनाक व्यवसायों हेतु 18+) के भारतीय नागरिक, न्यूनतम 5वीं पास; ट्रेड के अनुसार ITI उत्तीर्ण, कक्षा 8/10/12, डिप्लोमा, स्नातक एवं कौशल-प्रमाणपत्रधारक पात्र। पोर्टल पर पंजीकृत नियोक्ताओं के माध्यम से बिहार के युवाओं हेतु खुला।

summary.en: Provide fresh graduate, diploma and vocational-certificate holders with practical, on-the-job apprenticeship training (6 months to 1 year) under the Apprentices Act 1961, bridging the gap between classroom education and industry requirements.
summary.hi: नए स्नातक, डिप्लोमा एवं व्यावसायिक-प्रमाणपत्रधारकों को शिक्षुता अधिनियम 1961 के अंतर्गत 6 माह से 1 वर्ष तक का व्यावहारिक ऑन-द-जॉब शिक्षुता प्रशिक्षण देना।

records.evidence: Official NATS about-us page (Ministry of Education) confirms NATS 2.0 portal is operational with active establishments and stipend disbursal via DBT; PIB recorded launch of NATS 2.0 and disbursal of Rs 100 Cr stipends to graduates/diploma holders. Bihar graduates (2020-2024 cohort) are being actively enrolled per state notifications. Central scheme, no state budget line needed.

department.en: Ministry of Education, Government of India (implemented through Boards of Apprenticeship Training / BOATs; in Bihar via NATS 2.0 portal and graduate/diploma institutions)
department.hi: शिक्षा मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार (शिक्षुता प्रशिक्षण बोर्डों के माध्यम से; बिहार में NATS 2.0 पोर्टल द्वारा)

benefits.en: Hands-on apprenticeship training in an industry/establishment for 6 months to 1 year, a monthly stipend (aligned to minimum rates under the Apprentices Act; 50% of the stipend is reimbursed to the employer by the Government of India via DBT), and a Government of India Certificate of Proficiency registrable at employment exchanges as valid work experience. Widely promoted in Bihar as a ~Rs 9,000/month opportunity for recent graduates.

text.en: Graduate students, diploma holders and vocational certificate holders (engineering, technical, and now commerce/arts/humanities streams) seeking apprenticeship training; registration on the NATS 2.0 portal. No income or social-category bar; open to recent graduates including those in Bihar.
text.hi: शिक्षुता प्रशिक्षण चाहने वाले स्नातक, डिप्लोमा एवं व्यावसायिक-प्रमाणपत्रधारक; NATS 2.0 पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण। कोई आय या सामाजिक-श्रेणी बंधन नहीं; बिहार सहित नए स्नातकों के लिए खुला।

records.evidence: Fetched the National Trust Niramaya page (nationaltrust.nic.in/niramaya), which shows current coverage amounts, sub-limits, and a live claims helpline, indicating an actively administered scheme. Applies nationwide including Bihar residents registered with the National Trust.

department.en: The National Trust, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
department.hi: राष्ट्रीय न्यास, दिव्यांगजन सशक्तिकरण विभाग, सामाजिक न्याय एवं अधिकारिता मंत्रालय

benefits.en: Health insurance cover up to ₹1,00,000 per year (reimbursement basis) with sub-limits: hospitalisation/corrective surgeries (₹55,000), OPD incl. medicines/pathology/diagnostics and preventive dentistry (₹19,000), ongoing therapies (₹20,000), alternative/AYUSH medicine (₹4,000) and transportation (₹2,000). No exclusion for pre-existing conditions; no pre-insurance medical test.

text.en: Persons with disabilities covered under the National Trust Act (autism, cerebral palsy, mental retardation/intellectual disability, multiple disabilities) holding a valid disability certificate / UDID card or enrolment, registered with the National Trust. No income ceiling; premium varies by BPL/APL status.

title.en: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
title.hi: प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष्म खाद्य उद्यम उन्नयन योजना (PMFME)

summary.en: Enhance the competitiveness of existing micro food-processing enterprises and bring them into the formal economy through credit-linked capital subsidies, technical support, and capacity building.
summary.hi: मौजूदा सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यमों की प्रतिस्पर्धात्मकता बढ़ाना और ऋण-संबद्ध पूंजी सब्सिडी, तकनीकी सहायता एवं क्षमता निर्माण के माध्यम से उन्हें औपचारिक अर्थव्यवस्था में लाना।

records.evidence: Fetched official MoFPI PMFME page (mofpi.gov.in/en/pmfme/seed-capital-shg): describes PMFME as a current central sector scheme launched 29 June 2020 with a 5-year outlay (2020-21 to 2024-25) and an online application portal (pmfme.mofpi.gov.in). Scheme extended and operational per MoFPI 2024 annual report and PIB releases through 2025.

department.en: Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India
department.hi: खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार

benefits.en: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost up to Rs. 10 lakh per micro unit; seed capital of Rs. 40,000 per SHG member for working capital and small tools; grants for FPOs/SHGs/co-operatives for common infrastructure; branding and marketing support.

text.en: Existing individual micro food processing enterprises, proprietorships, partnerships, FPOs, SHGs, producer cooperatives, and self-help groups engaged in food processing. Open to Bihar-based units — state implementation through Bihar's nodal agency.
text.hi: मौजूदा सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण इकाइयाँ, एकल-स्वामित्व/भागीदारी, FPO, SHG, उत्पादक सहकारी समितियाँ एवं स्वयं-सहायता समूह। बिहार की इकाइयाँ राज्य की नोडल एजेंसी के माध्यम से पात्र।

attribution.name: Bihar Policy & Scheme Tracker by Vishal Arya / Bodhya
attribution.changes: Imported and normalized into the Sarkari catalogue; upstream evidence and original fields retained.

summary.en: Make renal-care/dialysis services accessible and affordable to poor (BPL) patients with chronic kidney disease / end-stage renal disease, addressing the financial burden of recurring dialysis.
summary.hi: गुर्दा रोग से ग्रस्त गरीब (BPL) रोगियों के लिए डायलिसिस सेवाएँ सुलभ एवं किफायती बनाना, बार-बार होने वाले खर्च के बोझ को कम करना।

records.evidence: Fetched the official MoHFW PMNDP portal introduction page (pmndp.mohfw.gov.in), describing it as launched 7 April 2016, currently operating across States/UTs in PPP/in-house/hybrid modes with a live PMNDP IT portal (launched May 2022). Bihar-specific reporting (State Health Society Bihar data cited in press) shows active district dialysis centres with sessions delivered as recently as 2024, confirming the program runs in Bihar.

department.en: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (operated in Bihar at district hospitals via State Health Society, Bihar)

benefits.en: Free dialysis services at district hospitals (in PPP and in-house modes), covering both haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis. For BPL economic group, 100% of expenses are covered under NHM by the government.

text.en: Below Poverty Line patients needing dialysis — eligibility evidenced by a National Food Security card or an income certificate showing annual income below ₹1 lakh, per search-sourced guidance.
text.hi: डायलिसिस की आवश्यकता वाले गरीबी-रेखा-से-नीचे (BPL) रोगी — राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा कार्ड या वार्षिक आय 1 लाख रु. से कम का प्रमाण-पत्र द्वारा पात्रता।

summary.en: Generate employment by helping individuals set up new non-agricultural micro-enterprises (manufacturing and service/business units) through a credit-linked margin-money subsidy.
summary.hi: ऋण-संबद्ध मार्जिन-मनी सब्सिडी के माध्यम से नए गैर-कृषि सूक्ष्म उद्यम स्थापित करने में सहायता देकर रोजगार सृजन।

records.evidence: Official MSME portal (my.msme.gov.in) and msme.gov.in list PMEGP as a current flagship scheme with a live online application portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegp). Implemented at state level through Bihar KVIC/KVIB/DIC. Listed as operational for 2025-26.

department.en: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME); implemented via KVIC nodal agency and, in Bihar, through State KVIC Directorate, Bihar KVIB and District Industries Centres (DICs) and banks
department.hi: सूक्ष्म, लघु एवं मध्यम उद्यम मंत्रालय (MSME); KVIC के माध्यम से, बिहार में राज्य KVIC निदेशालय, बिहार KVIB एवं जिला उद्योग केंद्रों द्वारा कार्यान्वित

benefits.en: Credit-linked margin-money subsidy. General category: 15% (urban) / 25% (rural) of project cost; special category (SC/ST/OBC/minorities/women/ex-servicemen/PwD/NER/hill/border): 25% (urban) / 35% (rural). Max project cost Rs.25 lakh (manufacturing) and Rs.10 lakh (service/business).

text.en: Any individual above 18 years; for projects above Rs.10 lakh (manufacturing) or Rs.5 lakh (service) the applicant must have passed at least Class VIII. Also open to SHGs, registered institutions/societies, production cooperatives and charitable trusts. Existing units and those who already availed subsidy under another govt scheme are not eligible.
text.hi: 18 वर्ष से अधिक का कोई भी व्यक्ति; निर्माण में 10 लाख रु. / सेवा में 5 लाख रु. से बड़ी परियोजनाओं हेतु कम-से-कम कक्षा 8 उत्तीर्ण। SHG, पंजीकृत संस्थाएँ, सहकारी समितियाँ एवं ट्रस्ट भी पात्र। मौजूदा इकाइयाँ / पहले से अन्य सब्सिडी प्राप्त इकाइयाँ अपात्र।

records.evidence: Fetched the NHM RBSK page (nhm.gov.in, level=0 linkid=499 lid=773), which describes RBSK as a current NHM child-health program with active mobile health teams and District Early Intervention Centres providing free screening and treatment. An NHM RBSK directory lists Bihar among implementing states.

department.en: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (implemented in Bihar by State Health Society, Bihar)
department.hi: राष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य मिशन, स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण मंत्रालय (बिहार में राज्य स्वास्थ्य समिति द्वारा कार्यान्वित)

benefits.en: Free screening of children for 30+ health conditions across the 4 Ds, plus free treatment and management including tertiary-level surgeries (e.g. congenital heart disease, cleft lip/palate, club foot, cataract, hearing impairment) and early-intervention services. All services free of cost; delivered via block-level mobile health teams and District Early Intervention Centres.

text.en: Children from birth to 18 years: 0-6 years in the community/anganwadi, and children enrolled in government and government-aided schools (classes I-XII). No income test.
text.hi: जन्म से 18 वर्ष तक के बच्चे: 0–6 वर्ष आँगनबाड़ी/समुदाय में, तथा सरकारी एवं सरकारी-सहायता प्राप्त विद्यालयों (कक्षा 1–12) के बच्चे। कोई आय-परीक्षण नहीं।

title.en: Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI) - Bihar

summary.en: Establish a dedicated RSETI in each district to impart short-term skill training oriented towards entrepreneurship/self-employment for rural unemployed youth, with long-term handholding for setting up micro-enterprises.
summary.hi: प्रत्येक जिले में एक RSETI स्थापित कर ग्रामीण बेरोजगार युवाओं को स्वरोजगार-उन्मुख अल्पकालिक कौशल प्रशिक्षण देना, सूक्ष्म उद्यम स्थापना हेतु दीर्घकालिक सहायता के साथ।

records.evidence: NIRDPR/MoRD official RSETI portal confirms the scheme is operational with district institutes, bank management, approved trades and progress reporting; PIB (2024) notes 590 RSETIs functioning across 572 districts in 33 States/UTs. MoRD national scheme, with RSETIs present in Bihar districts; dashboard.rural.nic.in carries state/district RSETI data including Bihar.

department.en: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India (sub-scheme of NRLM); RSETIs in Bihar districts are managed by sponsor banks (e.g., SBI and regional rural banks) with State Government cooperation
department.hi: ग्रामीण विकास मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार (NRLM की उप-योजना); बिहार के जिलों में RSETI प्रायोजक बैंकों द्वारा राज्य सरकार के सहयोग से संचालित

benefits.en: Free short-term residential skill training (from a basket of ~64 NCVET/MoRD-approved trades such as tailoring, dairy, electronics repair, apparel), followed by long-term handholding and credit-linkage support to start a self-employment venture. Reported settlement (self-employment/wage-employment) rate above 70%.

text.en: Rural poor unemployed youth aged 18-45 (priority to BPL households and NRLM/SHG members), enrolled through the district RSETI free of cost. Applicable to rural Bihar residents through the RSETIs operating in Bihar districts.
text.hi: 18–45 वर्ष के ग्रामीण गरीब बेरोजगार युवा (BPL परिवारों एवं NRLM/SHG सदस्यों को प्राथमिकता), जिला RSETI के माध्यम से नि:शुल्क नामांकन। बिहार के जिलों में संचालित RSETI के माध्यम से ग्रामीण निवासियों हेतु।

attribution.changes: Imported and normalized into the Sarkari catalogue; upstream evidence and original fields retained.
